b:if.script: {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"How do I join a WhatsApp group using an invite link?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eTap the link, then hit \u003cb\u003eJoin group\u003c/b\u003e in WhatsApp. That’s literally it\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003eFind a group you like here: use the search box or tap a category chip.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eTap \u003cb\u003eJoin group\u003c/b\u003e on its card.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eRead the 3 quick safety tips and tap \u003cb\u003eContinue to WhatsApp\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eWhatsApp opens the group’s invite page with its name, photo and member count.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eTap \u003cb\u003eJoin group\u003c/b\u003e. You’re in\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003eOn a laptop the link opens WhatsApp Web or the desktop app. Make sure you’re logged in there first.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eSee \u003cb\u003eRequest to join\u003c/b\u003e instead? The admin approves members by hand. Tap it and wait.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How do I find WhatsApp groups to join?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eSearch by what you’re into, your exam, your city or your language, then filter.\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003eType in the search box at the top of the list, e.g. \u003ci\u003ejobs\u003c/i\u003e, \u003ci\u003eNEET\u003c/i\u003e, \u003ci\u003ecricket\u003c/i\u003e, \u003ci\u003ememes\u003c/i\u003e, \u003ci\u003ePunjabi\u003c/i\u003e or \u003ci\u003eDubai\u003c/i\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eOr tap a category chip like \u003cb\u003eJobs \u0026amp; Careers\u003c/b\u003e, \u003cb\u003eEducation \u0026amp; Exams\u003c/b\u003e or \u003cb\u003eGaming\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eUse the \u003cb\u003eGroups / Channels\u003c/b\u003e switch to see only one kind.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eSort by \u003cb\u003eNewest\u003c/b\u003e for fresh groups or \u003cb\u003eA–Z\u003c/b\u003e to browse.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eWant a city or country? Open our \u003ca href=\u0027/search\u0027\u003egroup lists by city, country \u0026amp; topic\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003eFresh groups (marked \u003cb\u003eNEW\u003c/b\u003e) usually have working links and active admins.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eTurn on \u003cb\u003eAuto\u003c/b\u003e scroll (bottom right) to keep loading groups as you scroll.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Why can’t I join a WhatsApp group from a link?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eMost of the time the link was reset, the group is full, or the admin has to approve you.\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cb\u003e“This invite link was reset”\u003c/b\u003e or \u003cb\u003e“Link not valid”\u003c/b\u003e: the admin made a new link. Pick another group and tap the on the card so we remove it.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cb\u003e“Group is full”\u003c/b\u003e: WhatsApp groups max out at 1,024 members. Nothing you can do; try another.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cb\u003e“Request to join”\u003c/b\u003e: tap it and wait for an admin to approve you.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cb\u003eYou were removed before\u003c/b\u003e: only an admin can add you back.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cb\u003eNothing happens when you tap\u003c/b\u003e: update WhatsApp from the Play Store / App Store, then copy the link and open it in Chrome or Safari.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What does “Request to join” mean on a WhatsApp group?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eThe admin approves every new member by hand. You’re in once they say yes. ⏳\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003eOpen the invite link and tap \u003cb\u003eRequest to join\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eWait. The admins see your request in the group’s pending list.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eOnce approved, the group shows up in your Chats.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eChanged your mind? Open the same link again and tap \u003cb\u003eCancel request\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003eNo reply after a day or two? The admin may not be active. Try another group.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How many members can a WhatsApp group have?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eUp to \u003cb\u003e1,024\u003c/b\u003e members in one group, admins included.\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003eA normal group holds up to 1,024 people.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eNeed more? Admins use a \u003cb\u003echannel\u003c/b\u003e (unlimited followers, one-way posts) or a \u003cb\u003ecommunity\u003c/b\u003e that links several groups under one roof.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Will other members see my phone number in a WhatsApp group?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eYes. In a normal group everyone can see your number. In a channel, nobody can.\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cb\u003eAndroid\u003c/b\u003e: tap ⋮ (top right) → \u003cb\u003eSettings\u003c/b\u003e → \u003cb\u003ePrivacy\u003c/b\u003e. \u003cb\u003eiPhone\u003c/b\u003e: tap \u003cb\u003eSettings\u003c/b\u003e (bottom) → \u003cb\u003ePrivacy\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eTap \u003cb\u003eProfile photo\u003c/b\u003e → choose \u003cb\u003eMy contacts\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eDo the same for \u003cb\u003eAbout\u003c/b\u003e and \u003cb\u003eLast seen and online\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eNow group strangers see your number but not your photo, bio or last seen.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003eWant zero exposure? Follow channels instead of joining big public groups.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I join a WhatsApp group without the admin knowing?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eNope. The group shows a note that you joined via the link, and admins see every member.\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003eJust want to lurk and read updates? Follow a \u003cb\u003echannel\u003c/b\u003e instead: nobody sees who follows.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eSwitch the list here to \u003cb\u003eChannels\u003c/b\u003e to find one.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How do I leave a WhatsApp group quietly?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eExit the group: only the admins get told, not every member.\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003eOpen the group and tap its name at the top.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eScroll all the way down.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eTap \u003cb\u003eExit group\u003c/b\u003e, then \u003cb\u003eExit\u003c/b\u003e again to confirm.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eOptional: tap \u003cb\u003eDelete group\u003c/b\u003e afterwards to clear the chat from your phone.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003eJust too many pings? Tap the group name → \u003cb\u003eNotifications\u003c/b\u003e / \u003cb\u003eMute\u003c/b\u003e → \u003cb\u003eAlways\u003c/b\u003e, and stay in.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How do I stop strangers adding me to WhatsApp groups?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eSet who can add you to \u003cb\u003eMy contacts\u003c/b\u003e in Privacy. Done in 20 seconds.\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cb\u003eAndroid\u003c/b\u003e: ⋮ → \u003cb\u003eSettings\u003c/b\u003e → \u003cb\u003ePrivacy\u003c/b\u003e. \u003cb\u003eiPhone\u003c/b\u003e: \u003cb\u003eSettings\u003c/b\u003e tab → \u003cb\u003ePrivacy\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eTap \u003cb\u003eGroups\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003ePick \u003cb\u003eMy contacts\u003c/b\u003e, or \u003cb\u003eMy contacts except…\u003c/b\u003e to block certain people too.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eAnyone else now has to send you an invite, which you can just ignore.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What’s the difference between a WhatsApp group and a channel?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eGroup = two-way chat for up to 1,024 people. Channel = one-way broadcast anyone can follow.\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cb\u003eGroup\u003c/b\u003e: everyone can post, react and see each other’s numbers. Best for chatting.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cb\u003eChannel\u003c/b\u003e: only admins post; followers read, react and vote in polls. Your number stays hidden. Best for news, deals and updates.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eHere, flip the \u003cb\u003eGroups / Channels\u003c/b\u003e switch to see one kind only.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How do I follow a WhatsApp channel?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eOpen the channel link and tap \u003cb\u003eFollow\u003c/b\u003e. New posts land in your \u003cb\u003eUpdates\u003c/b\u003e tab.\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003eSwitch the list here to \u003cb\u003eChannels\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eTap \u003cb\u003eJoin channel\u003c/b\u003e on a card, then \u003cb\u003eContinue to WhatsApp\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eTap \u003cb\u003eFollow\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eOpen the \u003cb\u003eUpdates\u003c/b\u003e tab in WhatsApp to read it any time.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003eTo stop: open the channel → tap its name → \u003cb\u003eUnfollow\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can WhatsApp channel admins see my phone number?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eNo. Admins and other followers can’t see your number or profile photo.\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003eAdmins only see totals: how many followers, and how many people reacted to a post.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eYour reactions and poll votes don’t show your name or number to other followers.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How do I get my WhatsApp channel link?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eOpen your channel → tap its name → \u003cb\u003eShare\u003c/b\u003e → \u003cb\u003eCopy link\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003eOpen your channel in the \u003cb\u003eUpdates\u003c/b\u003e tab.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eTap the channel name at the top.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eTap \u003cb\u003eShare\u003c/b\u003e (or \u003cb\u003eShare channel link\u003c/b\u003e), then \u003cb\u003eCopy link\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eIt looks like https://whatsapp.com/channel/…. Paste it in the box at the top of this page to list it.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How do I create or copy a WhatsApp group invite link?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eGroup name → \u003cb\u003eInvite via link\u003c/b\u003e → \u003cb\u003eCopy link\u003c/b\u003e. Usually only admins see it.\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003eOpen your group and tap the group name at the top.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eScroll down to \u003cb\u003eInvite via link\u003c/b\u003e (iPhone: \u003cb\u003eInvite to group via link\u003c/b\u003e).\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eTap \u003cb\u003eCopy link\u003c/b\u003e. It looks like https://chat.whatsapp.com/…\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eSame screen also has \u003cb\u003eQR code\u003c/b\u003e (great for posters) and \u003cb\u003eReset link\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003eNot an admin and can’t see the option? Ask an admin, or ask them to allow everyone to invite in \u003cb\u003eGroup settings\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How do I add my WhatsApp group to ShareYourGroup? Is it free?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003e100% free, no account. Paste your link in the box at the top and tap \u003cb\u003eDrop it\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003eCopy your group or channel invite link (see the question above).\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003ePaste it in the box at the top of this page, or on the \u003ca href=\u0027/p/submit-your-group-links.html\u0027\u003eSubmit page\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eTick that your group follows the sharing rules.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003ePick a category and write one line about your group.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eTap \u003cb\u003ePublish\u003c/b\u003e. We pull the name and photo from WhatsApp for you.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How long does it take for my group to show up?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eInstantly. Your card pops up at the top as soon as you publish.\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003eYou see your card at the top of the list right away.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eEveryone else sees it the next time they open or refresh the page.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eIf WhatsApp is slow to share the name and photo, they fill in within about 15 minutes.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How can I get more members for my WhatsApp group?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eClear name, real photo, active chat, and share it everywhere your people hang out.\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003eGive it a clear name that says what it is, e.g. \u003ci\u003eDelhi Data Analyst Jobs\u003c/i\u003e, not \u003ci\u003eBest Group \u003c/i\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eUse a real group photo; it’s the first thing people see on your card.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eWrite a description that says who it’s for and how often you post.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003ePin your rules inside the group and post regularly; dead groups lose members fast.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eShare your card with the share button: Instagram bio, Stories, Facebook, Telegram, your WhatsApp Status.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eSubmit the same link again once a day to bump it back to the top.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003eDon’t spam other groups with your link. It gets you reported and can get your number banned.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I share my WhatsApp group link on Instagram, Facebook or Telegram?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eYep. Tap the share button on your card and pick the app.\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003eFind your group here and tap the share button (the three dots) on its card.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003ePick WhatsApp, Telegram, Facebook, X or Reddit, or tap \u003cb\u003eCopy\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eFor Instagram, paste the copied link in your bio or add it as a \u003cb\u003eLink\u003c/b\u003e sticker in Stories.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003eThe ShareYourGroup link shows your description and safety tips before people join, so you get fewer randoms.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How do I move my group back to the top of the list?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eSubmit the same link again. Works once every 24 hours. ⬆\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003ePaste the same invite link in the box at the top.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eTap \u003cb\u003eDrop it\u003c/b\u003e and \u003cb\u003ePublish\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eIf it’s been 24 hours since the last bump, your card jumps back to the top.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How do I reset my group link or remove my listing?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eReset the invite link in WhatsApp; the old listing dies at our next check.\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003eOpen the group → tap its name → \u003cb\u003eInvite via link\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eTap \u003cb\u003eReset link\u003c/b\u003e and confirm.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eThe old link stops working, and its card is removed at our next check.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eWant the group listed again? Submit the new link.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003eYour card’s name and photo refresh from WhatsApp automatically. Change them in WhatsApp.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eNeed it gone faster? \u003ca href=\u0027/p/contact-us.html\u0027\u003eContact us\u003c/a\u003e with the link.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Why was my group rejected or removed?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eIt broke a sharing rule, the link stopped working, or people reported it.\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cb\u003eRules\u003c/b\u003e: no adult or 18+ stuff, no “earn money” or money-doubling scams, no selling numbers or OTPs, no hate, violence or drugs.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cb\u003eDead link\u003c/b\u003e: the link was reset, the group was deleted, or it’s full.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cb\u003eReports\u003c/b\u003e: several visitors flagged it.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eFixed it or reset your link? Just submit the new link.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Is it safe to join WhatsApp groups from the internet?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eIt can be, if you treat members like strangers and lock your privacy first.\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003eSet your Profile photo, About and Last seen to \u003cb\u003eMy contacts\u003c/b\u003e (Settings → Privacy).\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eNever pay to join a group, and never share OTPs, PINs or bank details.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eDon’t open APK files or links that ask you to install apps.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eSomething feels off? Leave, report it in WhatsApp, and tap the on its card here.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e\u003cp\u003eWe block adult, scam and hate listings, re-check links and hide reported groups, but we don’t run or moderate the groups themselves.\u003c/p\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How do I spot a scam WhatsApp group?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eEasy money, “VIP” fees, task jobs or anyone asking for OTPs = run.\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003ePromises like “earn ₹5,000 daily”, “double your money” or “guaranteed profit”.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e“Task” jobs: like videos, rate hotels or review maps for money.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003ePaying to join a “VIP” group, or a “registration fee” for a job.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eAnyone asking for OTPs, UPI PINs or screen sharing.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eAPK files or links telling you to install an app.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003eReal groups never charge you to join. Leave, report it in WhatsApp and flag it here.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What should I never share in a WhatsApp group?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eOTPs, passwords, UPI PIN, bank or card details, Aadhaar/PAN photos and your live location. Ever.\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003eNo real bank, company, recruiter or admin will ask for these on WhatsApp.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eIf someone does, block and report them right away.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How do I report a WhatsApp group?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"\u003cp\u003eGroup name → scroll down → \u003cb\u003eReport group\u003c/b\u003e. Then flag it here too.\u003c/p\u003e\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003eOpen the group and tap its name at the top.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eScroll down and tap \u003cb\u003eReport group\u003c/b\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eChoose whether to also exit the group, then confirm. WhatsApp gets the last few messages to review.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eBack here, tap the on the group’s card and pick a reason.
